headline: Lehigh Valley IronPigs announce new ticket pricing structure for 2026 season
summary: The Lehigh Valley IronPigs unveiled a new dynamic pricing structure for the 2026 season. Weekend games and fireworks nights will see price increases of up to 15 percent, while weekday games drop by 10 percent. Season ticket holders are unaffected.

headline: Route 22 eastbound lane closures begin tonight for repaving project
summary: Drivers using Route 22 eastbound should plan for lane closures starting tonight at 9 p.m. PennDOT is repaving a stretch between Route 33 and 25th Street in Easton. Nightly closures run through Friday.
